content:
**The memory ledger shows what a record says and opens its full content inline (#1313)**

projectRecord dropped content and copied a title field that 0 of 2503 records set; every content starts with a bold **Title** line (C4 migration). New pure memory/lib/record-summary.mjs derives {title (bold lead, else first non-empty line, TITLE_MAX 200), excerpt (plain text, markdown stripped, EXCERPT_MAX 120, scan window 2000 chars)} or NO_TEXT/EMPTY_TEXT; projectRecord adds summary (amends #879 D3; content still not in the snapshot). Records section 450 KB -> 1.09 MB (+254 B/row), build +70 ms. Click expands the row inline (second tr, many open) with full content from a new local route /api/record/{id} (strict id pattern, no traversal, bounded, 404) rendered as markdown via the SDD worker path (never main thread). Publish canary raised to 10.4 MB.
